context.body: Preparation before David’s death becomes a direct charge to Solomon and the leaders.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: David identifies the future Temple site, gathers foreign workers and materials, tells Solomon that the promised son of rest will build, and commands Israel’s leaders to help.
observations.label: David prepares and charges Solomon to build: action

observations.body: Solomon receives a task tied to inherited preparation, peace, courage, wisdom, covenant obedience, skilled workers, and public support.
observations.label: David prepares and charges Solomon to build: response

observations.body: young and tender · son of rest · build a house · arise and be doing
observations.label: Words in 1 Chronicles 22:1–19

payload.posture: Read 1 Chronicles 22:1–19 as promise and succession evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The building promise is firm in assignment while Solomon’s prosperity is still spoken with covenant conditions.
payload.title: David prepares and charges Solomon to build
